questions.question: The results _____ tomorrow.
questions.explanation_cn: 主语是 results（结果），结果不会自己宣布，因此使用一般将来时的被动语态：will be + 过去分词。
questions.explanation_en: The subject 'results' receives the action, so the future passive 'will be announced' is required.

questions.question: English _____ in many countries around the world.
questions.explanation_cn: 英语是被人们说，因此使用一般现在时被动语态 is spoken。
questions.explanation_en: English receives the action, so use the present passive 'is spoken'.

questions.question: The experiment _____ by researchers before the report was published.
questions.explanation_cn: 实验先于报告发表完成，并且是被完成，因此使用过去完成时被动语态。
questions.explanation_en: The experiment was completed before another past event, requiring the past perfect passive.

questions.question: More than 5,000 questionnaires _____ during the survey.
questions.explanation_cn: 问卷是被收集，因此使用一般过去时被动语态。
questions.explanation_en: The questionnaires received the action, so use the past passive.

questions.question: It is widely _____ that regular exercise improves mental health.
questions.explanation_cn: 这是 IELTS 写作高频句型：It is widely believed that...（人们普遍认为……）。
questions.explanation_en: 'It is widely believed that...' is a very common academic passive structure.

questions.question: According to the report, over 80% of the waste _____ every year.
questions.explanation_cn: waste 是被回收，因此使用一般现在时被动语态。这类句型经常出现在 IELTS Reading 和 Writing Task 1。
questions.explanation_en: Waste receives the action, so use the present passive 'is recycled'.

questions.question: All applicants _____ to submit their supporting documents before the deadline.
questions.explanation_cn: 固定学术表达：be required to do sth（被要求做某事），常见于 IELTS 阅读和学校通知。
questions.explanation_en: 'Be required to' is a common academic passive structure meaning 'must do something'.

questions.question: The new policy _____ by the government to improve air quality.
questions.explanation_cn: 政策是'被推出'，并且强调已经完成且影响现在，因此使用现在完成时被动语态。
questions.explanation_en: The policy receives the action. The present perfect passive emphasizes a completed action with present relevance.

questions.question: Artificial intelligence _____ as one of the most influential technologies of the 21st century.
questions.explanation_cn: 固定表达：be known as（被称为……），是 IELTS/PTE 高频搭配。
questions.explanation_en: 'Be known as' is a fixed passive expression meaning 'be recognized as'.

questions.question: To reduce plagiarism, all assignments _____ through plagiarism detection software before grading.
questions.explanation_cn: 情态动词的被动语态：modal verb + be + 过去分词。
questions.explanation_en: The passive form after a modal verb is 'modal + be + past participle'.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences are grammatically correct?

options.text: The data were collected from over 2,000 participants.
Students are expected to complete the assessment independently.
The proposal has approved by the committee.
It is generally believed that regular exercise improves overall health.

questions.explanation_cn: A：正确，过去时被动语态。B：正确，be expected to 是学术英语固定表达。C：错误，应为 has been approved。D：正确，It is generally believed that... 是 IELTS Writing 高频句型。
questions.explanation_en: A correctly uses the past passive. B correctly uses the academic expression 'be expected to'. C is incorrect because it should be 'has been approved'. D correctly uses the common academic passive 'It is generally believed that...'.
